Topics covered in this PDF

BHIM-163 (History of India from 1707 to 1950) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Utilitarianism and British policy, Raja Ram Mohan Roy, economic impact of British rule, Non Cooperation movement, communalism
  • Permanent Settlement, the 18th century debate, the Moderates, Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar, Orientalism

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three assignments, answer all the questions, total marks 100
  • Assignment I: questions 1 and 2, about 500 words each, 20 marks each
  • Assignment II: questions 3 to 5, about 250 words each, 10 marks each
  • Assignment III: questions 6 to 10, about 100 words each, 6 marks each

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
